summary: 51-year-old woman lost while snowshoeing with two dogs near Lands End Observatory on the Grand Mesa; reported missing around 5:30 p.m., located the same evening after a 5+ hour night search thanks to a GPS emergency device she carried
responding_agency: Mesa County Sheriff's Office; Mesa County Search and Rescue (Snowskipper team)
notes: Date inferred: MCSO release gives only "Monday around 5:30 p.m."; corroborating report describes the rescue as "Monday evening" in a "busy start to 2022" article updated 2022-01-07, so Monday = 2022-01-03. Dogs accompanied her, counted as human victims=1 per convention.
